{{Top|leg}}
'''''Devil''''' was a group of three [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle]]s used by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The shuttles were escorting two pirate [[Cargo ferry|cargo ferries]] ''[[Filcher]]'' and ''[[Riirdo]]'' which stole two [[Class-A cargo container|containers]] worth of munitions from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] armory and arranged a rendezvous with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to trade them. However [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] and two [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]]s followed them in pursuit to reclaim the munitions and demanded their surrender. The pirates refused as they believed that with the Rebel starfighters and two more cargo ferries ''[[Redbill]]'' and ''[[Wippet]]'' they had the numbers to fight of the Imperials.

The Gunboats managed to outfight the numbers and the escort shuttles were destroyed. The pirate cargo ferries were disabled and the crews were arrested. The Rebels were defeated and the munitions recovered by [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifters]] ''[[Amgis]]''. The incident was recorded and recreated for the [[Combat chamber]] to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]] such as [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
